 Nov 04, 2026 at 12:07 PM Ines Diaz Digital Content Coordinator
 Copied! 
 The San Francisco 49ers will host the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 9 of the 2026 regular season at Levi's® Stadium. The matchup is set to kick off at 1:25 p.m. PT on Sunday, November 8. Here are all the ways to follow the game presented by Visa.
 HOW TO WATCH
 Watch the game on TV FOX
 Stream the game NFL+ : Watch live local, primetime, regular season, and postseason games on your phone or tablet, game replays, and more.
 Watch internationally Fans in Mexico can watch the game live on Fox + and Fox One.
 Fans in the UK can watch the game live on Sky Sports +.
 Fans in the UK, UAE, Mexico, and across international markets can watch every live NFL game on Game Pass International on DAZN .
 For more ways to watch, click here .
 HOW TO LISTEN
 U.S. Bank 49ers Radio Network All 49ers games can be heard on KSAN (107.7 FM "The Bone") and KNBR (104.5 FM/680 AM) and the 49ers Radio Network.
 Fans can also listen live on the 49ers App or on 49ers.com .
 Spanish Radio Network The live game broadcast featuring announcers Jesús Zárate and Carlos Yustis will be streamed at no cost to fans exclusively on the 49ers App or at 49ers.com/esp . To view all of the team's Spanish content, please click here .
 Mexico Broadcast The Raiders vs 49ers Week 9 game will be broadcast on radio via W Deportes 730 AM.
 UK Broadcast The game will be broadcast on radio via talkSPORT.
 For more ways to listen, click here .
